name: pmfby_claim_authenticate_farmer
description: Authenticates a farmer for PMFBY claim services using Aadhaar and OTP. Requires a valid Aadhaar registered with PMFBY and a matching mobile number. Inputs must be exactly 12 digits for Aadhaar, 10 digits for mobile, and 6 digits for OTP. Returns a session_token for accessing private policy and claim data. Does not submit claims or notify losses. Fails if the OTP is incorrect, expired, or if the Aadhaar is not enrolled in PMFBY.

otp.description: 6-digit One Time Password sent to the registered mobile number [EXACT]

name: pmfby_claim_get_loss_event_notifications
description: Retrieves official notified crop loss events for a specific district and season. Requires no prior authentication or session state. Inputs must be valid state, district, season, and year strings. Returns a list of loss_event_id, calamity_scope, loss_cause, and official notification dates. Does not check individual farmer policy status or submit notifications. Fails if the state or district is invalid, or if no data exists for the specified year and season.

name: pmfby_claim_get_claim_window_status
description: Checks if the window for submitting loss notifications or claims is currently open for a given region and calamity type. Requires no prior state or authentication. Inputs must specify valid location, season, year, and calamity_scope. Returns boolean flags for notification_window_open and claim_window_open, along with deadline dates. Does not submit any claims or validate farmer details. Fails if the location parameters are unrecognized or if the season and year combination is in the future.

name: pmfby_claim_get_area_yield_data
description: Retrieves historical and current Crop Cutting Experiment (CCE) area yield data and threshold yields for widespread calamity assessment. Requires no authenticated session. Inputs must be valid location, crop, season, and year. Returns threshold_yield and actual_yield in quintals per hectare. Does not calculate individual farmer compensation or assess localized damage. Fails if CCE data is not yet published for the requested crop and season, or if location details are invalid.

name: pmfby_claim_get_insurer_contact
description: Retrieves the contact details of the insurance company assigned to a specific district for a given season under PMFBY. Requires no authentication or prior state. Inputs must be valid state, district, season, and year. Returns insurer_name, toll_free_number, email_address, and local_office_address. Does not raise grievances or contact the insurer directly. Fails if the district was not covered under PMFBY for the specified season and year.

name: pmfby_claim_verify_active_policy
description: Verifies the status and details of a specific PMFBY policy for the authenticated farmer. Requires an active authenticated session. Inputs must include a valid session_token and a policy_id belonging to the farmer. Returns policy_status, insured_crop, sum_insured, and farmer_category. Does not initiate any claim or loss notification. Fails if the session is invalid, if the policy_id does not belong to the authenticated farmer, or if the policy_status is cancelled or lapsed.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for all tools that submit, modify, or access private policy, claim, and compensation data [TYPE_ONLY]

policy_id.description: Unique PMFBY policy identifier for the enrolled crop and season [EXACT]

name: pmfby_claim_submit_loss_notification
description: Submits a formal intimation of crop loss for a specific policy and loss event. Requires an authenticated session and a policy with policy_status: active. Inputs must include a valid policy_id, a recognized loss_event_id for the district, and a loss_date within the allowed reporting window. Returns a unique notification_id and loss_notification_status. Does not submit the final claim or calculate compensation. Fails if the policy is not active, if the loss_date is more than 72 hours in the past for a localised calamity resulting in late_submission, or if a notification already exists for this policy and event.

name: pmfby_claim_get_notification_status
description: Retrieves the current status of a previously submitted crop loss notification. Requires an active authenticated session. Inputs must include a valid session_token and a notification_id belonging to the farmer. Returns loss_notification_status, remarks, and deadline for formal claim submission if accepted. Does not modify the notification or submit a claim. Fails if the session is invalid, or if the notification_id does not exist or belongs to a different farmer.

name: pmfby_claim_submit_claim
description: Submits a formal crop loss claim under an active PMFBY policy. Requires an authenticated session, policy_status: active, and a loss_notification_status: accepted. Inputs must include valid policy_id, notification_id, and claimed area not exceeding insured area. Returns claim_id, claim_status, and assigned survey_approach. Does not assess yield loss or calculate compensation. Fails if no active policy exists, if the notification was rejected or not submitted, if the claimed area exceeds the insured plot area, or if a claim already exists for the same policy and loss event.

name: pmfby_claim_get_claim_status
description: Retrieves the current lifecycle status of a submitted PMFBY crop loss claim. Requires an active authenticated session. Inputs must include a valid session_token and a claim_id belonging to the farmer. Returns claim_status, loss_cause, calamity_scope, and last_updated_date. Does not modify the claim or fetch detailed compensation financial breakdowns. Fails if the session is invalid, or if the claim_id is unrecognized or unauthorized for the current user.

name: pmfby_claim_get_surveyor_assignment
description: Retrieves details of the surveyor assigned to assess localized crop damage for a specific claim. Requires an authenticated session and a claim with claim_status: surveyor_assigned or later. Inputs must include a valid claim_id. Returns survey_status, surveyor_name, surveyor_contact, and scheduled_visit_date. Does not assign a surveyor or record survey results. Fails if the claim_id is invalid, if the calamity_scope is widespread which uses area_yield_cce instead of individual survey, or if no surveyor has been assigned yet.

name: pmfby_claim_get_survey_result
description: Retrieves the findings of a completed individual crop damage survey. Requires an authenticated session and a claim with survey_status: completed. Inputs must include a valid claim_id. Returns assessed_loss_percentage, surveyor_remarks, and survey_completion_date. Does not calculate final monetary compensation or disburse payments. Fails if the claim_id is invalid, if the survey_status is not_assigned or in_progress, or if the claim relies on area yield data rather than an individual survey.

name: pmfby_claim_get_compensation_details
description: Retrieves the calculated compensation amount and breakdown for a processed claim. Requires an authenticated session and a claim with compensation_status: calculated or approved. Inputs must include a valid claim_id. Returns compensation_status, calculated_amount, threshold_yield, actual_yield, and shortfall_percentage. Does not initiate the actual bank transfer or disburse funds. Fails if the claim_id is invalid, if the compensation_status is not_calculated or calculating, or if the actual yield was above the threshold yield resulting in zero compensation.

name: pmfby_claim_get_payment_status
description: Tracks the DBT payment status of an approved PMFBY claim. Requires an authenticated session and a claim with claim_status: payment_initiated or disbursed. Inputs must include a valid claim_id. Returns payment_status, credited_amount, bank_account_last_four, utr_number, and payment_date. Does not calculate the compensation amount or modify bank details. Fails if the claim_id is invalid, if the claim has not been approved for payment, or if the payment_status is not_initiated.

name: pmfby_claim_request_correction
description: Submits a request to correct errors in a filed claim before final approval. Requires an authenticated session and a claim with claim_status: filed or surveyor_assigned. Inputs must include a valid claim_id, a recognized correction_type, and a descriptive reason. Returns a correction_id and updated claim_status. Does not process the correction immediately or change compensation amounts directly. Fails if the claim_id is invalid, if the claim_status is already approved, disbursed, or rejected, or if the correction_type is not applicable to the current claim state.

name: pmfby_claim_raise_grievance
description: Files a formal grievance or dispute regarding a PMFBY claim. Requires an authenticated session and a valid claim_id. Inputs must include the claim_id, a valid grievance_category, detailed description, and optionally a disputed_amount. Returns a unique grievance_id and grievance_status. Does not resolve the grievance or automatically adjust compensation. Fails if the claim_id does not exist, if the grievance is filed more than 30 days after the compensation decision, or if a grievance is already active for the same issue.

name: pmfby_claim_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks the resolution status of a previously filed PMFBY claim grievance. Requires no authenticated session token. Inputs must include a valid grievance_id and the registered mobile_number of the farmer. Returns grievance_status, resolution_remarks, and last_updated_date. Does not allow filing new grievances or modifying existing ones. Fails if the grievance_id is not found, if the mobile_number does not match the one associated with the grievance, or if the input formats are invalid.

grievance_id.description: Unique identifier for the filed grievance [TYPE_ONLY]
